note: Literature check of 16 Nov 2026 for best known makespans or lower bounds of the basic MSRCPSP on MSLIB1 to MSLIB4 published after the release v2.2 (11 Mar 2026) of the library. Nothing found changes a cell; the checks are listed so that they can be repeated.

checked.source: J. Snauwaert and M. Vanhoucke, A classification and new benchmark instances for the multi-skilled resource-constrained project scheduling problem, EJOR 307 (2023) 1-19

checked.source: MSLIB release v2.2, sheet MSRCPSP (basic), read with two separately written xlsx readers (tools/mmrcpsp_cells.py's and openpyxl)
